This can yield overlapping/invalid removal intervals and incorrect total_duration_seconds, breaking downstream removal correctness and report consistency.",
      "repair_instruction": "Implement full normalization and merging: robustly parse segments from inputs, coerce start/end to numeric, clamp start/end to >=0 (and optionally clamp end to a provided/known total duration), drop/repair segments where end <= start, sort by start, merge overlapping or directly-adjacent segments using the explicit rule next.start <= prev.end, recompute each segment.duration = end - start, and compute total_segments and total_duration_seconds from the merged output.
